tokyo_la_beaute_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask. The hot pots finish as risotto or rice porridge, and lunch is soup, salad and multigrain rice, but appetizers include spring rolls and croquettes and the desserts include pound cake; nothing gluten-free is described.
tokyo_la_beaute_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Ask. Over 20 vegetables go into each hot pot, but the broths named are soft-shell turtle with bonito, chicken bone, tomato or basil with meat, fish or seafood, and the lunch soups include clam chowder and chicken; no vegan option is stated.
tokyo_la_beaute_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon–Fri lunch 11:30–14:00 and dinner 17:00–23:00; Sat and holidays dinner 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Lunch bookings only for 4 or more or for the lunch hot-pot course; dinner bookings any time (Tabelog). Lunch fills at opening (January 2025). 20 seats: a counter of 6 and four tables; whole-shop hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards accepted (Tabelog).
tokyo_la_beaute_yotsuya.notes: [Hot pot · Yotsuya, herbal hot pots from a one-person kitchen] A calm second-floor room in a Yotsuya back lane where one owner cooks and serves herbal hot pots with an Italian accent: two broths side by side — tomato and basil for the "Anti-Aging Nabe", soft-shell turtle and spicy chicken bone for the beauty pot, curry and salt for the detox pot — with twenty-odd vegetables, your choice of meat or fish, and a risotto or porridge to finish. Weekday lunch is a bargain: two herbal soups, salad and multigrain rice for about ¥1,000, and the place fills at opening. Save room for the owner's ice cream, drawn from more than 300 recipes and flavours found on travels, such as red wine and fig. Diners in 2025–26 praise the food and the owner's warmth.

roles: Owner, cooking and serving alone (reviews)
chef_bio.background: No source names the owner. "Surprisingly, there was only one staff member managing everything" (January 2025); "Although it is run by just one person, the service is prompt" (February 2025); "The owner changes the ice cream flavors daily" (October 2025); "over 300 recipes! The owner has traveled to many countries and uses ingredients discovered during [those] travels in [the] ice cream" (May 2026). Tabelog: herbal ingredients chosen with care to make traditional Chinese medicine easy to enjoy; at least 12 vegetables per hot pot; seasonal hot pots. A March 2025 diner notes the building's first floor is Osteria Pinocchio.
chef_bio.philosophy: To make medicinal cuisine more accessible and delicious (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Herbal hot pots; homemade ice cream.

anecdotes.text: "For dessert, I chose the owner's special ice cream, with about seven flavors to choose from. The red wine and fig ice cream was incredibly delicious." — October 2025.
"I could choose between large, medium, or small portions of rice at the same price." — January 2025, half-and-half herbal soup lunch.
"They offer three types of hot pots: medicinal hot pot, beauty hot pot, and detox hot pot." — March 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラ・ボーテ、鍋・イタリアン・ダイニングバー、四谷2-3-19 四谷大新ビル2F、南北線四ツ谷駅2番出口から徒歩3分、JR四ツ谷口5分、月〜金11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:00、土・祝17:00〜23:00、日曜休み、ランチの予約は4名以上か鍋ランチコースのみ、20席 (カウンター6、テーブル)、貸切20名、禁煙、カード可、イタリアン薬膳鍋「アンチエイジング鍋」、トマトとバジルのスープ、野菜は最低12種。口コミ(2025年1月〜2026年5月): 店主ひとりで営む、薬膳スープ2種のランチ900〜1,000円、14穀米、すっぽんと鶏ガラの美容鍋、カレーと塩のデトックス鍋、締めのリゾットや雑炊、自家製アイスは300種以上のレシピ、薬膳酒。

cultural_comfort.note: One person cooks and serves; book dinner; set hot pots make ordering easy.

tokyo_kitajima_tei_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Classic French with bread and butter, a bacon quiche among the amuses, flour-dusted fish, butter and cream sauces, tarts and baked sweets (2026 reviews); nothing gluten-free is described.
tokyo_kitajima_tei_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat, foie gras, fish and shellfish courses with butter and cream.
tokyo_kitajima_tei_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon and Thu–Sun (and holidays) lunch 11:30–15:00 (last food order 12:30) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (last food order 19:00); closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations by phone; an August 2026 diner was offered a weekday the following month (Japanese review). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). 12 seats at tables; whole-shop hire; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Allow about 3 hours (August 2026).
tokyo_kitajima_tei_yotsuya.notes: [French · Yotsuya, a classic bistro of big portions under a yellow awning] Behind a faded yellow awning in Yotsuya Sanei-cho, a 12-seat French restaurant that the shop says has been a standout for about a quarter of a century, cooked by chef Motoyuki Kitajima in an unfashionably generous, butter-and-sauce classical style. Courses of three or four dishes (¥16,940 or ¥18,150, the same price for 12 years, says one regular) arrive with amuses, granité, dessert and a box of petits fours, and many diners can't finish: the famous Nemuro sea-urchin consommé jelly, foie gras with corn galette, flounder in a potato crust with a dense fish-soup sauce. 2026 diners loved the cucumber soup, the uni and the wine pairings; others found the sauces rough, the lamb fatty, a fish slightly off and the precision behind the volume, and one regular wonders how long the ageing chef will keep cooking. Book by phone; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

roles: Chef (Tabelog: "Motoyuki Kitajima - A Gourmet Explorer Who Mastered the Essence")
chef_bio.background: Tabelog (shop text): a French restaurant with a striking yellow-and-blue front, "a standout for nearly a quarter of a century"; the chef wants to "master the essence", avoiding trendy techniques and complex presentation for robust dishes that maximise the ingredients. Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2020 and 2026; French TOKYO "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023, 2025. A September 2026 diner calls it one of the "Four Kings of Japanese French Cuisine"; another writes "Given that Chef Kitajima is getting older, I wonder how much longer [the chef] will be active." No source gives the kanji of the chef's given name.
chef_bio.philosophy: To master the essence: no trends, no fuss, maximum flavour from the ingredients (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Uni consommé jelly; foie gras with corn galette; generous classic courses.

anecdotes.text: 「メニューはコースが3品(16940円)・4品(18150円)の2種類…北島亭では12年前から値段が据え置かれていました。」 — August 2026, a return after 12 years.

"Although it's called a '4-dish' course, it actually includes four selected dishes along with soup, appetizers, palate cleansers, desserts, and baked sweets… I couldn't finish the last baked sweet, so I took it home." — September 2026.

"The quantity was substantial, something not often seen in recent Tokyo French cuisine… However, I felt that the precision and delicacy of the dishes did not quite match the volume." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 北島亭、フレンチ、四谷三栄町15-2 JHCビル1F、四ツ谷駅から徒歩5分、月・木〜日・祝11:30〜15:00 (料理L.O.12:30)・18:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.19:00)、火曜・水曜休み、サービス料10%、12席、禁煙、カード可、食べログアワード Bronze 2017〜2020・2026、フレンチ TOKYO 百名店2021・2023・2025、シェフは Motoyuki Kitajima。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): コースは3品16,940円と4品18,150円 (12年前から据え置きという声)、きゅうりの冷製スープ、雲丹のコンソメジュレ、紅ズワイガニとアスパラガスのシャルロット仕立てのサラダ、フォアグラのポワレととうもろこしのガレット、平目のじゃがいもづけ焼き、蔵王の鴨のロースト、紅茶のプリン、小菓子6種、量が多い、黄色いテント、仕上げが粗いという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; choose dishes within the course; shared choices for groups.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (Bronze 2026); reviews dated through October 2026.

tokyo_eishinkan_bakery_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask. A September 2026 diner reports the signature kinako butter bread is made by wrapping kinako butter in a rice-flour dough, but nothing is labelled gluten-free and the shop also bakes croissants, Danish, pizza and other breads in the same kitchen.
tokyo_eishinkan_bakery_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature bread is filled with Hokkaido cream butter, and the range includes butter breads, egg mayo, sausage and pizza.
tokyo_eishinkan_bakery_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 10:00–15:00; closed Wednesday, Saturday, Sunday and holidays (Tabelog), though an October 2026 diner bought bread on a Saturday afternoon. The kinako butter bread is baked several times a day and other breads sell out by the afternoon (March and September 2026). A free coffee, tea or rooibos with any bread purchase (2025–26 reviews). 6 seats at three small tables (Tabelog; September 2026). E-money and QR such as PayPay; no cards (Tabelog; October 2026). Bakery opened January 2021 (February and September 2026 reviews).
tokyo_eishinkan_bakery_yotsuya.notes: [Bakery · Yotsuya, the inn's kinako butter bread] A tiny bakery in the entrance of the Eishinkan, a long-running inn on the corner of Yotsuya Saka-machi, opened in 2021 to share the bread served at the inn's breakfast with the neighbourhood. The draw is the kinako butter bread, ¥260: organic roasted-soy flour and Hokkaido cream butter wrapped in a rice-flour dough, crunchy on top and molten inside when it comes from the oven several times a day. Daily sweet and savoury breads, a pizza of the week and mini sizes fill the case, and every purchase comes with a free coffee or tea at one of three little tables in the sunlight. Go before lunch for the full range. Open four weekdays, 10:00–15:00.

chef_bio.origin: Bakery opened January 2021 in the Eishinkan inn (2026 reviews); the inn: "Our main business, Eishinkan, has been operating at its current location since 1953" (Tabelog); "established in 1935" per a September 2026 review.
chef_bio.background: No source names the owner or bakers. Tabelog remarks: "Our main business, Eishinkan, has been operating at its current location since 1953." Reviews describe the inn as in business for 87 or 90 years (February and January 2026) and established in 1935 (September 2026); the bakery was opened "with the intention of sharing the bread served at breakfast with the local community" (September 2026). An event stall at Ikebukuro Tobu is mentioned (December 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Sharing the inn's breakfast bread with the neighbourhood (September 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: "I arrived just in time for the freshly baked bread! The kinako butter inside was still hot and melting, so I was warned to hold it carefully and eat it straight away." — March 2026.
"This round bread is made by wrapping organic soybean kinako and Hokkaido fresh cream butter in a rice flour dough and baking it." — September 2026.
"When you buy bread, they offer a complimentary drink, so I enjoyed a warm rooibos tea." — December 2025.

tokyo_hakata_tonkotsu_ichiban_okachimach.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thin wheat noodles in pork-bone broth; the vegetable topping comes in a thick sauce.
tokyo_hakata_tonkotsu_ichiban_okachimach.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone broth, back fat, rare pork chashu; mentaiko on the table.
tokyo_hakata_tonkotsu_ichiban_okachimach.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–2:00, until sold out (Tabelog). Bookings through Tabelog put you in the line on arrival rather than holding a seat (October 2026). Queues of about 10 at times; quieter mid-afternoon. Ticket machine, then an order sheet for noodle firmness, fat, spice and toppings (October 2026). No cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog); extra noodles paid in cash at the counter. 15 counter seats. Non-smoking. Free Wi-Fi. English menu and staff; listing also notes Vietnamese- and Sri Lankan-speaking staff. Opened 13 January 2023.
tokyo_hakata_tonkotsu_ichiban_okachimach.notes: [Ramen · Okachimachi, clear tonkotsu ramen until 2 am] A 15-seat ramen counter a minute from Okachimachi's North Exit that calls itself the birthplace of clear tonkotsu: a pork-bone broth that stays transparent yet tastes of pork, with a punch of garlic. Buy a ticket, then fill in an order sheet for noodle firmness, fat and toppings. The special clear tonkotsu (¥1,650) comes ringed with slices of rare chashu; the plain bowl is only ¥650, and stir-fried vegetables in a thick sauce come on the side. Mentaiko on the table is free. Open from 11:00 to 2:00 every day, with a line at lunch. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog official listing; the counter seating was crafted by the owner, per an October 2026 review. No source names the owner.

anecdotes.text: "I started with the broth, and I was surprised by its clarity despite being tonkotsu!" — October 2026, special clear tonkotsu ramen.
"The broth was a clear tonkotsu, light yet easy to drink, with a punch of garlic that added depth to its flavor, contrary to its appearance." — October 2026.
"The seasoning was quite strong, but everything else was average." — October 2026, tonkotsu ramen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (公式情報): 博多豚骨らぁ麺一絆 上野御徒町本店、上野6-4-18、JR御徒町駅北口から徒歩1分、毎日11:00〜翌2:00 (売り切れ次第終了)、予約可、15席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、Wi-Fi、英語のメニューとスタッフ、2023年1月13日オープン、「世界初、透明豚骨らぁ麺発祥の店」。メニュー (2026年10月): 豚骨素ラーメン650円、豚骨ラーメン800円、特製1,000円、豚骨野菜ラーメン1,000円、透明豚骨野菜ラーメン1,200円、特製透明豚骨ラーメン1,650円、替え玉・野菜増し・ライス各150円、レアチャーシュー300円、卵かけご飯350円。口コミ (2026年10月): 食券のあと注文用紙で麺の硬さや脂を指定、レアチャーシュー、野菜炒めは別皿、卓上の明太子は無料、10人ほどの行列、店主手作りのカウンター。

cultural_comfort.note: Tabelog lists an English menu and English-speaking staff; ticket machine plus an order sheet.

tokyo_cafe_bell_ueno_park.gf_detail: GF — ask: curry, Napolitan spaghetti, fried fish, sandwiches and cakes; nothing is described as gluten-free.
tokyo_cafe_bell_ueno_park.vegan_detail: Not vegan: curry, hamburg steak, fried fish with tartar sauce, omelette, cakes and soft-serve; no vegan dish is named.
tokyo_cafe_bell_ueno_park.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 9:30–17:00; closed Mondays, the third Wednesday of each month and public holidays (Tabelog). Lunch from 11:30 (July 2026); popular dishes like curry sell out early (September 2026). Inside the International Library of Children's Literature, open to all ages (July 2026). Buy a ticket from the machine (cash only), hand it in, take a number and collect your food. Tabelog lists 10 table seats; reviewers describe closely packed tables and a terrace. Non-smoking.
tokyo_cafe_bell_ueno_park.notes: [Café · Ueno Park, cheap lunch inside a historic library] A simple self-service café on the ground floor of the International Library of Children's Literature, housed in the brick building that was once the Imperial Library, with a modern glass wing and a terrace. Buy a ticket (cash only), collect your tray when your number is called, and eat for well under ¥1,000: a ¥550 curry that reviewers rate like an old Western-style restaurant's, Napolitan spaghetti, a ¥700 bento-style set, or coffee for ¥400 with a cake set at ¥650. Lunch starts at 11:30 and fills up near noon; curry can sell out. Closed Mondays, public holidays and the third Wednesday. The library's children's-literature gallery upstairs is worth the visit too.

chef_bio.background: Café in the International Library of Children's Literature (Tabelog lists the library site as its website). No source names the operator.

anecdotes.text: "The curry is at the level of a long-established Western-style restaurant, making it undoubtedly delicious." — July 2026, large omurice curry.
"Until the beginning of this year, coffee was just JPY 300 (JPY 320 for iced)… the price had increased to JPY 400 (JPY 450 for iced)." — July 2026.
"The food was a bit cold, but it was quick and convenient." — August 2026, daily special ¥800.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ ベル、上野公園12-49 国際子ども図書館内 1F、鶯谷駅から448m、火〜日9:30〜17:00、月曜・第3水曜・祝日休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、10席 (テーブル)、テラス、禁煙。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月): カレーライス550円、ナポリタンが名物、オムライスカレー、ハンバーグカレー、お得なセット700円 (白身魚フライと回鍋肉の弁当)、日替わり800円、コーヒー400円 (アイス450円、年初までは300円・320円)、ランチのドリンク150円、ケーキセット650円、かき氷、ソフトクリーム、食券は現金のみ、番号札で呼ばれる、昼は満席に近い、カレーは早く売り切れる。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine (cash), number tag, self-service; no English menu is listed.

tokyo_ramen_senju_okachimachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: medium-thick curly wheat noodles in a miso, salt or soy-sauce soup.
tokyo_ramen_senju_okachimachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soup sealed with lard, pork chashu, egg.
tokyo_ramen_senju_okachimachi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–21:00; closes when the soup sells out — check the shop's Instagram (Tabelog). No reservations. Long queues since opening: 1 hour 15 minutes at 11:30 in November 2026 (a reviewer suspected a TV feature); 14 outside and 5 inside at 13:30 in October 2026; shorter mid-afternoon. Ticket machine, then a waiting area inside. 14 counter seats. Non-smoking. No cards; transport IC and QR (PayPay, d Barai, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay). No table charge. Children welcome. Opened 1 September 2026.
tokyo_ramen_senju_okachimachi.notes: [Ramen · Okachimachi, Sapporo miso ramen with a queue] The first Tokyo branch of Senju, a Sapporo miso-ramen shop founded in 2002 and named in Tabelog's Hokkaido ramen 100 in 2024 and 2025, opened by Okachimachi Station in September 2026. Expect the Sapporo style: a rich, slightly salty miso soup sealed under a layer of lard so it stays hot, garlic and ginger, and springy curly noodles (miso ramen ¥1,100; with bean sprouts and ginger ¥1,250). Salt and soy-sauce versions too. Lines have been long — over an hour at lunch in November 2026, which a reviewer put down to a TV feature — and the shop closes when the soup runs out. A few reviewers found it milder or less hot than the Sapporo greats.

chef_bio.origin: Branch of ramen senju, founded in Sapporo, Hokkaido, in 2002; this shop opened 1 September 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review, the Sapporo original is run by a chef who trained at Sumire. No source names the chef in Okachimachi.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the listing: a bowl you would want to eat every day.

anecdotes.text: "After waiting for 1 hour and 15 minutes, I finally got my bowl. I ordered the regular Miso Ramen for JPY 1,100" — November 2026.
"The surface was coated with oil, keeping the ramen hot until the very last bite" — October 2026, miso ramen.
"Compared to other places like Oshima and San Tora, the miso, broth, and noodles are a bit weaker." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (公式情報): らぁめん千寿 御徒町店、上野4-2-5 美濃里ビル 1F、JR御徒町駅北口・上野広小路駅A5出口・上野御徒町駅A5出口から徒歩1分、毎日11:00〜21:00 (スープがなくなり次第終了、公式Instagramで案内)、予約不可、14席 (カウンター)、禁煙、カード不可・交通系IC・QR可、チャージなし、2026年9月1日オープン、2002年札幌創業、ラーメン 百名店 北海道 2024・2025、30種以上の食材を炒めた味噌スープ、千寿専用の中太縮れ麺。メニュー (2026年8月): 味噌らーめん1,100円、もやし生姜1,250円、チャーシュー1,500円、特製1,600円、塩・醤油も同じ。口コミ (2026年10〜11月): 開店以来の行列、テレビで紹介後は1時間以上待ち、ラードでスープが冷めない、にんにくと生姜、札幌の本店はすみれで修業した店主、ほかの名店より穏やかという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine; queue outside, then a waiting area; no English menu is listed.

existence.note: Tabelog official listing (opened 1 September 2026); reviews dated October–November 2026.

tokyo_sardexka_shitaya.gf_detail: GF — ask: a set course of small vegetable and seafood dishes; no gluten-free statement, so tell the restaurant when booking.
tokyo_sardexka_shitaya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the courses include fish, octopus, Iberico pork and pork-blood spring rolls, and the paella is seafood.
tokyo_sardexka_shitaya.hours_raw: Dinner Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun, holidays 18:30–23:00; closed Thursdays and some irregular days (Tabelog). Lunch on Wednesdays and Sundays by reservation (Tabelog menu, January 2026); reviewers had a Sunday paella lunch (November 2026) and a weekend lunch (August 2026). Reservations only — TableCheck, or message by SMS, email, Instagram or Facebook; the phone is not for inquiries. Courses start as each guest arrives (November 2026). 8 counter seats. Non-smoking. No children (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR. Opened 23 May 2016.
tokyo_sardexka_shitaya.notes: [Spanish · Uguisudani, an eight-seat Basque counter] A tiny counter restaurant on a quiet street between Uguisudani and Iriya, open since 2016 and in Tabelog's Spanish 100 for 2024 and 2026. The chef trained in the Basque Country and cooks small, gentle dishes from Japanese seasonal produce — piquillo peppers, pisto, tender octopus, crisp sea bream, salmon belly — in omakase courses of about nine or ten plates (¥7,000 or ¥9,000), with dessert extra. Lunch is on Wednesdays and Sundays by reservation; the lunch courses reviewers had ended with a generous seafood paella (about ¥8,800). Two people run it, the chef and one other; a November 2026 reviewer describes a husband-and-wife team. Reservations only, by TableCheck or message; no children.

chef_bio.background: Per an August 2026 review, the chef trained in the Basque region. Run by two people — the chef and a staff member (September 2026), described as a husband-and-wife team in November 2026. No source names the chef.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the website: "日本の旬とスペインの香り" — Japanese seasonal ingredients with the aroma of Spain, cooked with a Japanese sensibility.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase of small Basque-style dishes; paella.

anecdotes.text: "The sauces crafted by the chef are truly artistic. Especially the citrus-based sauce, which perfectly balances acidity, bitterness, sweetness, and umami." — May 2026.
"Although it was said to be Basque cuisine, it felt more like creative dishes using Japanese ingredients rather than traditional regional dishes." — September 2026, ¥7,000 course.
"The final dish, paella, was quite generous in portion size, leaving me feeling full." — August 2026, ¥8,800 lunch course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (公式情報): sardexka、下谷1-6-7 竹内マンション 1F、JR鶯谷駅南口・入谷駅から徒歩5分、月火水金土日祝18:30〜23:00、木曜休み (ほか不定休)、完全予約制 (TableCheck、SMS、メール、Instagram・Facebook)、8席 (カウンター)、禁煙、子ども不可、カード可、2016年5月23日オープン、食べログ スペイン料理 百名店 2024・2026。メニュー (2026年1月): おまかせ約10品9,000円、約9品7,000円、ランチは水曜・日曜 (要予約)。公式サイト: バスク語でフォーク、日本の旬とスペインの香り。口コミ (2026年5〜11月): バスクで修業したシェフ、二人で営業 (11月の口コミでは夫婦)、ピキージョ、ピスト、タコ、鯛、鮭、なすと豚の血の春巻き、パエリアのランチコース8,800円、コースは来店順に始まる。

tokyo_shogetsu_an_ningyocho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soba with wheat (a June 2026 diner notes it is not even the typical 2:8), katsudon, ramen and yakisoba.
tokyo_shogetsu_an_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba served in a bonito broth (March 2026).
tokyo_shogetsu_an_ningyocho.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–21:30; closed Sat and Sun (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire possible (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Smoking allowed except 11:30–13:00 (Tabelog; a March 2026 diner notes smoking from 13:00). Delivery (June 2026). Packed with office workers at weekday lunch, sometimes a short wait outside; food comes out within about five minutes (2026 reviews). In business at least 50 years (June 2026 review).
tokyo_shogetsu_an_ningyocho.notes: [Soba · Ningyocho, the cheap, fast neighbourhood soba shop] An old-style neighbourhood soba shop, at least fifty years in business, that fills with office workers at weekday lunch. The sets are the draw: soba with a katsudon, gyudon or egg bowl and a salad for ¥800, and kake soba at ¥450. Food arrives within minutes. The soba is thin and chewy in a bonito broth, nothing fancy. In the evening it turns into a soba-shop izakaya, with a ¥1,500 deal of drinks and two dishes. Not every bowl lands: diners found warm soba overcooked in June and cold noodles not cold enough in July and August 2026. Cash only; smoking is allowed outside the 11:30–13:00 lunch window. Weekdays only.

chef_bio.background: In business for at least 50 years and offering delivery (June 2026 review). A September 2026 diner had frequented a since-closed "Edobashi Shogetsu An" and found this shop with the same name; no source links the two.

anecdotes.text: "The service is incredibly fast" — June 2026.
"The curry nan-soba costs JPY 850. By the way, the kake-soba is only JPY 450." — September 2026.
"Warm soba noodles unfortunately give off a strong impression of being overcooked." — June 2026, a seventh visit.

tokyo_raifuku_tei_ningyocho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breaded menchi katsu and cutlets, hayashi and curry sauces.
tokyo_raifuku_tei_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg, chicken, pork and beef dishes.
tokyo_raifuku_tei_ningyocho.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–13:45 and 17:00–19:45; closed Sat and Sun (Tabelog) — though an October 2026 diner had lunch there on a Saturday. Summer break 8–11 August 2026, lunch only 12–14 August (August 2026 review). No reservations. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 12 seats: two tables downstairs and a tatami room upstairs, shoes off (Tabelog; August–October 2026). Non-smoking. Founded in 1904 (August, September 2026 reviews).
tokyo_raifuku_tei_ningyocho.notes: [Yoshoku · Ningyocho, a 1904 Western-food house beside Tamahide] A tiny yoshoku restaurant in an old house next to 玉ひで, said to date from 1904, with two tables downstairs and a tatami room upstairs where you take off your shoes. The owner's mother carries the plates up the stairs (August 2026). The order most people make is the omurice, ketchup rice in a thin omelette, with a small menchi katsu on the side for ¥1,200; others choose katsudon, pork sauté or the crab fried rice. It feels like a Showa time slip, prices included. One diner found the katsudon a little salty, and another the menchi on the small side. Cash only; weekday lunch and an early dinner until 19:45.

roles: The owner's mother serves (August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Founded in 1904 (August, September 2026 reviews). An August 2026 reviewer gives the owner's family name as "Oshio", then reports the nameplate outside read "Oshidori"; the two do not match, so no name is recorded.
chef_bio.specialty: Omurice with a small menchi katsu.

anecdotes.text: "When you go up to the second floor, there’s a tatami room. The owner’s mother brings the dishes up with great care." — August 2026.
"It featured a classic omurice with two green peas on top, and instead of ketchup, it was served with a rich Hayashi sauce." — September 2026, mini omurice.
"The Menchi Katsu paired well with the sweet sauce and was delicious. … the portion size is on the smaller side." — August 2026.

tokyo_wakai_horidome.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat egg noodles; fried rice alongside.
tokyo_wakai_horidome.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone broth with stir-fried minced pork.

Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 30 seats: 10 at the counter, two tables for four and tatami seating; a private room for 8 (Tabelog). tokyo_wakai_horidome.notes: [Ramen · Horidome-cho, three-generation Sapporo miso ramen in a back alley] A Showa-era ramen shop hidden in an alley so narrow that diners doubt their maps, run by three generations of one family: a grandmother, a mother and a son (August 2026). The wok works over high flames, stir-frying bean sprouts and minced pork before the broth and miso go in, in the old Sapporo style. The result is gentle rather than lardy, with curly yellow noodles and an unusual topping of seaweed stems; regulars add corn and butter, or a ¥200 mini fried rice. Celebrity autographs cover the walls, and the shop has appeared in a film (October 2026). Lunch fills with office workers by noon. Cash only; Saturdays only twice a month.

roles: Family-run across three generations — a grandmother, a mother and a son (August, October 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a long-established shop; staff are a grandmother, a mother and a son; the master stirs the broth pot and the wok (August, October 2026). Signed photos of celebrities on the walls; the shop has appeared in a film (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Miso ramen with stir-fried bean sprouts and minced pork.

anecdotes.text: "The staff consisted of a grandmother, a mother, and a son, and the kitchen and dining area were bustling with the lively atmosphere of a popular spot." — August 2026.
"Fire!! Flames erupted from the Chinese wok! I thought I might singe my bangs!" — October 2026.
"The seaweed topping (JPY 100) is not the thin kind, but rather the stem seaweed, which has a great texture and is delicious." — December 2025.

tokyo_tempura_yaguchi_ningyocho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: everything is in a wheat-flour batter, and the chef discusses the wheat flour brands used (November 2025).
tokyo_tempura_yaguchi_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-led tempura omakase (shrimp, squid, anago, sea urchin).
tokyo_tempura_yaguchi_ningyocho.hours_raw: Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Lunch and dinner are both omakase courses; reservations by phone only (Tabelog). Tabelog notes the lunch tendon is sold out (no longer offered). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR; no service charge (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; private hire possible; non-smoking; from junior-high age (Tabelog). Opened 1 July 2020 (Tabelog).
tokyo_tempura_yaguchi_ningyocho.notes: [Tempura · Ningyocho, an eight-seat counter from a Mikawa Zezankyo disciple] An eight-seat tempura counter on Daimon-dori, opened in July 2020 by a chef who trained some 22 years at Mikawa Zezankyo under the master Tetsuya Saotome; a certificate signed by Saotome hangs on the wall (March 2026). Lunch and dinner are the same long omakase, often near twenty pieces: two shrimp and their heads, two kinds of squid fried to be told apart, red eggplant gone creamy, clams cooked rare, sea urchin in shiso, anago, then a small kakiage bowl. Diners praise the precise heat, the light finish and the chef's humour and talk across the counter. A May 2025 reviewer calls it Michelin-starred; it was a Tabelog Tempura 100 pick in 2025. One June 2026 diner found some pieces over-dried, the beer warm and the champagne overpriced. Phone bookings only; closed Thursdays.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yaguchi or Taniguchi (sources differ: "Yaguchi-san" in a November 2025 review, matching the shop name; "Mr. Taniguchi" / "Chef Taniguchi" in February, March and August 2026 reviews; no kanji source)
roles: Owner-chef, about 22 years at Mikawa Zezankyo before opening (May 2025, August 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: trained about 22 years at Mikawa Zezankyo under Tetsuya Saotome before opening on 1 July 2020 (May 2025; February, August 2026); a certificate of mastery signed by Saotome hangs on the wall; during the pandemic the shop sold a ¥2,000 lunch tendon to support Tsukiji wholesalers (March 2026). A May 2025 reviewer describes it as a Michelin one-star restaurant. Selected for Tabelog Tempura 100 in 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Light tempura that stays easy to eat however many pieces you have (November 2025 review); ingredients chosen for how they suit the frying and batter (February 2026 review).

tokyo_hashimoto_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. The duck hot pot has a rich soy-sauce broth (November 2025), and the menu includes tonkatsu, tempura and agedashi tofu; nothing is said about gluten.
tokyo_hashimoto_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: duck hot pot with chicken tsukune, and seafood and meat side dishes.
tokyo_hashimoto_roppongi.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); Sat 18:00–22:00; closed Sundays and Mondays; occasional closures (Tabelog). The owner runs the shop alone, so food takes time: order a little more at the start and drinks early (2025–2026 reviews). Fridays get busy — book. 5% service charge plus an appetizer charge. 18 seats: 6 at the counter and three sunken-kotatsu tables for 4; shoes off; whole-shop hire. Non-smoking (smoking allowed for private parties with no other guests). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay). A wooden sign in front; next to the Jinro building (Tabelog).
tokyo_hashimoto_roppongi.notes: [Izakaya · Roppongi, a one-person duck hot-pot izakaya since 1978] A quiet tatami izakaya a stone's throw from Tokyo Midtown — shoes off, a short counter and three sunken tables — that has served its duck hot pot since 1978. The owner cooks and serves alone: duck and garlic chives with tsukune and vegetables in a slightly rich soy broth, then zosui, plus small homemade drinking dishes sized to your group and about fifteen well-known sakes. Diners in 2025–2026 call it a calm, good-value hideaway for Roppongi; one has been coming since 1986. Food comes slowly, so order early and settle in. Duck hot-pot course ¥4,750; book for Fridays.

chef_bio.chef_name: 橋本 洋一 (as registered; no romaji in the sources)
roles: Owner (the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: The NTA invoice register lists registration number T6810522686872 — the number on the Tabelog listing — under the individual 橋本 洋一 (registered 1 January 2026). Diners in 2025–2026 describe the owner running the shop alone, with a gentle manner. An October 2026 diner says the izakaya was established in 1978 and has served its duck hot pot since opening; a December 2025 diner has been a regular since 1986.
chef_bio.philosophy: A Japanese space away from the bustle; carefully made homemade drinking dishes and sake (Tabelog shop text).

anecdotes.text: "The owner, who runs the place solo with a gentle demeanor, takes some time to serve the dishes" — November 2025, duck hot-pot course.
"One delightful aspect is that … dishes in smaller portions according to the number of diners." — October 2026.
"I have been a regular customer since 1986, and this wonderful establishment never fails to deliver consistent quality in both food and warm hospitality." — December 2025.

tokyo_shunsai_gyo_ai_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Seafood kaiseki with tempura (salted, February 2024), crab vinegar and a light-soy turtle broth (Tabelog shop text); nothing is said about gluten.
tokyo_shunsai_gyo_ai_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: crab, fugu, seafood, soft-shelled turtle and game.
tokyo_shunsai_gyo_ai_roppongi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and days before/after holidays: lunch 11:30–13:30 (last order 13:00), by reservation at least one business day ahead; dinner 17:00–22:00 (food last order 21:30) — the shop note gives dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); takeaway 16:30–22:00, same-day orders at least 4 hours ahead; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). ¥4,200 charge for appetizers and dessert (included in courses). Soft-shelled turtle course needs booking 4 days ahead. 28 seats: 8 at the counter, three tables for 4, two tatami rooms for 6; private hire up to 50. Non-smoking; smoking area outside the entrance. tokyo_shunsai_gyo_ai_roppongi.notes: [Kaiseki · Roppongi, a seafood kaiseki by Midtown with crab, fugu and turtle] A calm counter-and-tatami restaurant in a side street by Tokyo Midtown, open since about 1996, that serves seasonal Japanese cooking built on fine seafood: Maizuru black abalone, alum-free Rishiri sea urchin, Kōbako and hairy crab in winter, aged fugu and Seki mackerel, and a soft-shelled turtle course (¥19,700) whose broth is just sake, kombu and light soy. Reviewers in 2025 also met horse sashimi, narwhal bacon and a moon-bear hot pot. Diners praise the warm service in the dining room; several warn that prices are not on the menu and the bill can surprise. Weekday dinner and booked lunches.

chef_bio.background: A November 2023 diner says the restaurant opened around 1996 and describes young counter staff and a woman managing the dining room warmly. The Tabelog course text is written in the first person by someone who has tried soft-shelled turtle hot pots across Japan. No one is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood kaiseki; Kōbako crab; soft-shelled turtle hot pot.

anecdotes.text: "Finally, the moment for the snow crab arrived. The first of the season was beautifully filled with both the inner and outer roe as well as the meat." — November 2023, lunch course ¥14,300.
"A surprising highlight was the bacon made from narwhal, which had a unique flavor and a sweet richness that was truly addictive." — October 2025 visit.
"From the outside, it doesn't radiate luxury, so it makes you wonder if you might run into a surprise when you casually stop by." — March 2023.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 旬菜魚 藍、港区六本木4-4-3 六本木協和ビル西館1F、大江戸線六本木駅7番出口から徒歩1分、月〜土・祝前日・祝後日11:30〜13:30 (昼は1営業日前までに要予約)、17:00〜22:00 (店のメモでは23:00まで)、テイクアウト16:30〜22:00、日祝休み、先付・デザート4,200円 (コースは込み)、28席 (カウンター8、テーブル4席×3、座敷6名×2)、貸切50名まで、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可。店の紹介: Maizuru の500gの黒鮑、Rishiri のミョウバン不使用の北紫雲丹、毛蟹、すっぽんのコース19,700円 (4日前までに予約)。口コミ(2017年〜2025年11月): 1996年ごろ開店、からすみの餅米、八寸、香箱蟹、ふぐと Seki の鯖、鱧、天然鰻、馬刺し、イッカクのベーコン、月の輪熊の鍋、鯛めし、値段が書かれておらず会計に驚いたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Courses and host-chosen dishes; ask prices in advance.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing with courses; reviews dated through November 2025.

tokyo_bistro_vino_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Burgers, pasta, gnocchi and bread are on the menu (2026 reviews); nothing is said about gluten.
tokyo_bistro_vino_roppongi.vegan_detail: Ask. Grilled vegetables appear on the autumn menu (October 2025), but most dishes are meat, seafood or cheese and no vegan dishes are described.
tokyo_bistro_vino_roppongi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 and 16:00–23:00 (16:00–17:00 drinks only); Sat 11:30–23:00; Sun and holidays 11:30–22:00; food last order an hour before closing; open all year except New Year (Tabelog). No table charge. 91 seats: tables, a large table, a 16-seat counter and 33 on the terrace; private hire for 50+, with sound equipment. Non-smoking; smoking area on site. Wheelchair access. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (PayPay).
tokyo_bistro_vino_roppongi.notes: [Wine bistro · Roppongi, an all-day wine bistro with a big terrace] A large, airy bistro on the ground floor of the Pyramide building near Roppongi Hills, with a wall of wine at the door, a long counter and a 33-seat terrace. Lunch is burgers, sandwiches and steaks; from 4 pm it turns into a wine bar with over 100 bottles and plates to share — burrata with fruit and prosciutto, truffle hash browns with Pecorino, Gorgonzola gnocchi, oysters. Diners in 2026 use it for after-work drinks, parties and second stops, and found the staff efficient. Open every day from 11:30; a Thanksgiving turkey dinner runs 21–29 November.

chef_bio.background: Run by Bistro Vino六本木株式会社 (job listing at en-gage.net). An English-language guide notes it was formerly called Roti (metropolisjapan.com). No one is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.specialty: Wine by the glass and bottle; truffle hash browns.

anecdotes.text: "For lunch, … Western dishes like burgers, sandwiches, and steaks, and it transforms into a bar at night." — July 2026.
"The hash browns are bite-sized, packed with truffle flavor and plenty of Pecorino cheese!" — September 2026.
"As soon as you open the door, you’re greeted by a stunning display of wines lined up from top to bottom." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Bistro Vino、港区六本木6-6-9 ピラミデビル1F、六本木駅から徒歩2分、月〜金11:30〜14:30、16:00〜23:00 (16〜17時は飲み物のみ)、土11:30〜23:00、日祝11:30〜22:00、年末年始以外は無休、チャージなし、91席 (テラス33席)、貸切50名以上、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)、カード・電子マネー・QR可。サンクスギビングディナー8,980円 (11月21〜29日)。口コミ(2025年10月〜2026年10月): 昼はハンバーガー、サンドイッチ、ステーキ、夜はワインバー、100種以上のボトルワイン、ブッラータと果物と生ハム、トリュフのハッシュポテト、ゴルゴンゾーラのニョッキ、牡蠣。運営 Bistro Vino六本木株式会社。

cultural_comfort.note: Large casual bistro; wine list and photo-friendly sharing plates.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing with a November 2026 course; reviews dated through October 2026.

tokyo_takano_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-style obanzai and seasonal dishes, including fried fugu and bamboo-shoot tempura (2024–2025 reviews); nothing is said about gluten.
tokyo_takano_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: obanzai with fish such as herring, plus fugu, crab and sea-bream dishes.
tokyo_takano_roppongi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00; closed Sundays (Tabelog). 19 seats: a counter and two tables for 4 (November 2025); whole-shop hire. Non-smoking. Cards (JCB, AMEX only); no e-money or QR. Walk-ins welcome but booking advised — it is small (February 2024). Book the sea-bream chazuke in advance (October 2023 visit). A cosy room where it is best to keep the noise down (October 2023 visit).
tokyo_takano_roppongi.notes: [Obanzai · Roppongi, a 1996 back-alley kappo of obanzai and fugu] At the end of a one-way street behind Tokyo Midtown, a small, homely kappo of 19 seats, open since 1996, where the counter is lined with bowls of obanzai — herring with eggplant is the one people mention — and the menu follows the seasons: fugu sashimi, fried fugu and fin sake in winter, Kōbako crab, matsutake, hamo. The chef trained in Kyoto and Osaka, comes from Niigata and pours its sake; dinner ends with a sesame sea-bream chazuke or a long-simmered fugu zosui. Diners from 2023 to 2026 call it authentic Japanese food at a surprisingly fair price in a calm, old-Roppongi atmosphere. JCB and AMEX only.

chef_bio.background: Established in 1996, drawing on training in Osaka and Kyoto and on traditional Niigata dishes (Tabelog shop text). Reviewers add that the chef trained for 15 years at Akasaka Tsuyama and also in Osaka (February 2024), trained for many years in Kyoto and comes from Niigata (November 2025), and has run the shop for a long time; part-time staff are mostly regulars' children (December 2025). The chef is not named in the sources read.
chef_bio.philosophy: Homemade Japanese food has become rare; savour obanzai and seasonal dishes with good sake in a calm setting (Tabelog shop text).

anecdotes.text: "Dining at Takano makes expensive Japanese cuisine seem ridiculous, as you can enjoy authentic dishes at a surprisingly low price." — February 2024, fugu.
"On weekends, … a delicious fugu (pufferfish) zosui (rice soup) that simmers for hours." — December 2025.
"Everything was delicious, but the simmered eggplant and herring was irresistible for someone like me who loves eggplant." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): たか野、港区六本木4-4-3 六本木協和ビル西館1F、月〜土18:00〜23:00、日休み、19席、貸切可、禁煙、カード (JCB、AMEX のみ)。店の紹介: 1996年創業の六本木の路地裏の割烹、Osaka と Kyoto での修業と Niigata の郷土料理、おばんざいと季節の料理と日本酒。口コミ(2023年10月〜2026年5月): カウンターに並ぶおばんざい、鰊茄子、煮こごり、冬のふぐ (刺身、唐揚げ、白子、ひれ酒)、香箱蟹、松茸、鯛茶漬け、ふぐ雑炊、Niigata の酒 Tsurunoe Yukionna、店主は Akasaka Tsuyama で15年修業という声、Niigata 出身、値段が手頃。

cultural_comfort.note: Small regulars' kappo; obanzai chosen from the counter.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

tokyo_chuka_soba_yamashita_yotsuya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in a soy-seasoned niboshi broth.
tokyo_chuka_soba_yamashita_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dried-sardine broth (and chicken and pork in the rich version), chashu.
tokyo_chuka_soba_yamashita_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–14:45; closed Saturday (since 15 July 2025, for now) and Sunday (Tabelog). The shop borrows a yakiniku and horumon motsunabe izakaya at lunch (Tabelog remarks; 2026 reviews). No reservations. Ticket machine at the entrance; cash only (Tabelog; July 2026). 30 seats, all at tables, some sofas; wheelchair accessible; children welcome (Tabelog). A line forms after noon on weekdays (October 2026). Opened 9 May 2022 (Tabelog).
tokyo_chuka_soba_yamashita_yotsuya.notes: [Ramen · Yotsuya, a weekday niboshi pop-up inside a horumon izakaya] From the street it looks like a yakiniku place, and at night it is one: on weekday lunchtimes the room becomes Chuka Soba Yamashita, a niboshi specialist that a TRY Ramen Award named a best new shop. Buy a ticket at the door for the clear niboshi chuka soba (¥800), light but full of dried-sardine flavour from four kinds of niboshi with kombu and shiitake, or the rich niboshi soba, a thick chicken-and-pork broth heavy with sardine; the special adds several chashu. Finish the soup with zosui rice. Barley tea comes in a beer mug. Opinions split: many 2026 diners call the bowls excellent, while one found the niboshi flavour lost and another the ramen ordinary, and in October 2026 orders came out of turn under a new server. Weekdays only, 11:00–14:45.

chef_bio.origin: Opened 9 May 2022 (Tabelog); an October 2026 diner calls it "a branch of the Ningyocho Yamashita".
chef_bio.background: No source names the cook. Reviews cite a TRY Ramen Award newcomer prize ("TRY Ramen Award 2021-2022, award-winning new shop for niboshi", June 2026). Tabelog remarks: "Lunchtime rental at Yakiniku Hormone Motsu-nabe". An October 2026 diner notes the chef cooking noodles alone while a new part-timer struggled with serving.
chef_bio.specialty: Niboshi chuka soba; rich niboshi soba.

anecdotes.text: "The broth is made with four types of niboshi (dried sardines), kombu kelp, and shiitake mushrooms." — September 2026, light soy-sauce ramen and chashu bowl.
"The soup was thicker than I expected. The flavor is based on a chicken-paitan broth with niboshi (dried sardines)." — May 2026, rich niboshi soba, large.
"I thought I was next in line after the customer ahead of me, but 2-3 groups who arrived after me were served their ramen first, resulting in a long wait." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華そば 山下、ラーメン、四谷2-3-6 パルム四谷1F、四ツ谷駅から徒歩6分、四谷三丁目駅7分、月〜金11:00〜14:45、土日休み (2025年7月15日から当面土曜も休み)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、30席 (テーブル)、禁煙、車椅子可、子ども可、2022年5月9日オープン、昼は焼肉ホルモンもつ鍋の店を借りて営業。口コミ(2026年4月〜10月): 煮干し中華そば800円、味玉950円、濃厚煮干しそば1,000円・特製1,350円、4種の煮干しと昆布と椎茸、鶏豚の白湯、ストレートの中太麺、雑炊ご飯、チャーシュー丼、ビールジョッキの麦茶、TRY Ramen Award の新人の賞、Ningyocho Yamashita の支店という声、配膳の順番が前後したという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine at the door, cash only; table seating.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

tokyo_shukou_aji_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi is the heart of the menu, but there are simmered fish, tempura (vegetables, firefly squid), fried young ayu and an okara side; nothing gluten-free is described.
tokyo_shukou_aji_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish izakaya; even the appetizer trio is usually fish or shellfish.
tokyo_shukou_aji_yotsuya.hours_raw: Tabelog lists no hours; an evening izakaya that opens at 17:30 (November 2025 booking at opening). Reservations taken (Tabelog); tables fill early (December 2025). Appetizer charge ¥500 (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 17 seats: a counter of 4 and three tables; non-smoking, smoke outside; a sign asks guests to keep voices low; Japanese-style toilet (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
tokyo_shukou_aji_yotsuya.notes: [Izakaya · Yotsuya, a couple's fish tavern in an alley] A small, old-looking izakaya down an alley near Yotsuya Station, run by a couple — the owner cooks and the owner's wife helps, as an October 2025 diner describes it — with a handwritten menu of fish from Toyosu that changes with the catch. Start with the three-dish appetizer, then sashimi that a 2025 regular compares to a good sushi bar, the house moon-viewing sardines with egg yolk, aji namero, ankimo and simmered kinmedai; the fish-ball yude pon has been on the menu since opening. Featured on the TV drinking shows Sakaba Hourouki and Onna Sakaba Hourouki. Quiet by request, cash only, and best booked: the three tables go early.

roles: Run by a couple (reviews)
chef_bio.background: No source names the owners. "It's a cozy place run by a married couple" (April 2024); "This small restaurant, run by a couple… The owner's gentle hospitality and [the owner's] wife's support made for a wonderfully comfortable experience" (October 2025); "run by a lovely couple" (April 2026). Reviews mention the owner going to Toyosu market (April 2024) and TV appearances on Yoshida Rui's Sakaba Hourouki and Hiromi Terasawa's Onna Sakaba Hourouki (June 2026).

anecdotes.text: "I always order the signature moon-viewing sardines… my companion, who was visiting for the first time, exclaimed, 'I want to have it over warm white rice!'" — April 2025.
"Terasawa-san recommended the classic 'Yude Pon' (boiled fish balls) that has been on the menu since the establishment's opening." — June 2026.
"In these times of rising seafood prices, finding quality fish dishes at an affordable price is a rare opportunity." — July 2026, katsuo, fried young ayu, hamo and simmered kinmedai.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒肴 味、居酒屋、三栄町3-6、四ツ谷駅から徒歩6分、営業時間の記載なし、予約可、お通し代500円、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、17席、禁煙 (店外で喫煙)。口コミ(2023年11月〜2026年7月): 夫婦で営む、手書きのメニュー、Toyosu の魚、お通し3品、刺身の盛り合わせ、名物のいわしに卵とねぎを合わせた一品 (英語の口コミで moon-viewing sardines)、あじのなめろう、あん肝850円、穴子や金目鯛の煮付け、ほたるいかの天ぷら、若鮎の揚げ物、だし巻き、おから、開店以来の Yude Pon、oki-jiru 1,000円、日本酒は Ichinokura の燗700円、Sakaba Hourouki と Onna Sakaba Hourouki に登場、店内は静かに。

cultural_comfort.note: Handwritten Japanese menu that changes daily; small and quiet; cash only.

tokyo_love_asia_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask. Khao man gai and som tum are not wheat-based dishes, but Thai sauces often include soy or oyster sauce, and the menu has spring rolls and coriander tempura; nothing gluten-free is described.
tokyo_love_asia_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Ask. A basil tofu (gapao tofu) and coriander tempura appear, but Thai dishes usually carry fish sauce and the curries contain meat; no vegan option is stated.
tokyo_love_asia_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon–Sat lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Saturday happy hour 17:00–19:00 with drinks at half price via a Tabelog coupon (December 2025). Courses with all-you-can-drink, including bottled Thai beers (April 2025, October 2026). Lunch is often busy (April 2025). 15 seats: counter, sofas, semi-private seating for 5–6; hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; August 2025). Cards, e-money and QR including PayPay (Tabelog). Takeaway (September 2025).
tokyo_love_asia_yotsuya.notes: [Thai · Yotsuya, a basement Thai bar with draft Singha] Down the stairs in a building just off Shinjuku-dōri, a small Thai bar where a Japanese chef in love with Thailand cooks the classics — khao man gai, gapao, pad thai, a herb-heavy, properly hot green curry — and plays Asian records on vinyl. Lunch sets are about ¥1,100; at night there are courses with all-you-can-drink that even include bottled Thai beers, draft Singha, and a coriander sour; Saturday 17:00–19:00 drinks are half price with a Tabelog coupon. Reviews vary on the khao man gai: moist and well-sauced for some, cold, dry and carelessly plated for 2025 lunch diners. The owner is friendly; one 2025 diner found a single person running the room. Closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: No source names the chef. Tabelog (corporate-member listing): "A Thai cuisine enthusiast from Japan who loves Thailand offers delicious Thai dishes and Asian drinks at reasonable prices", with Asian music on vinyl. Reviews: "run by a Japanese chef" (October 2026); "The service was efficient, even with just one staff member" (April 2025); "The owner is friendly" (September 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Khao man gai; green curry; draft Singha.

anecdotes.text: "From 5 PM to 7 PM, drinks are half price! This is quite impressive, as even the Singha draft beer is half off. From JPY 550 to JPY 275!" — December 2025, Saturday.
"The Green Curry is incredibly delicious. It's packed with Thai herbs and has a strong spiciness." — April 2026.
"The Khao Man Gai was surprisingly very cold, as if it had just come out of the refrigerator, and the chicken was a bit dry." — February 2025, lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ラブエイジア四ツ谷、タイ料理・居酒屋・バル、四谷2-9-15 サンサーラ四谷ビルB1F、四ツ谷駅から徒歩7分、月〜土11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、日曜・祝日休み、15席、貸切20名、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、タイ好きの日本人が作るタイ料理とアジアのお酒、アジアの音楽をレコードで、ガパオライス、パッタイ、パクチーの天ぷら、樽生の Singha。口コミ(2025年2月〜2026年10月): ランチ1,100円前後 (カオマンガイ、ガパオ)、グリーンカレー、ソムタム、ガイヤーン、ガパオ豆腐、飲み放題のコース、土曜17〜19時のハッピーアワー、カオマンガイが冷たく乾いていたという声も、日本人のシェフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Small basement bar; lunch sets and courses make ordering easy.

tokyo_spice_curry_shokudo_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask. Two October and September 2026 diners say the Sri Lankan curries are made without wheat flour and with little oil, and the plate is rice, curries, sambols and a lentil papadam; the shop itself makes no gluten-free claim, so confirm, especially for the spice mixes.
tokyo_spice_curry_shokudo_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Ask. The listing ticks "Vegetarian options" and a diner mentions a vegetarian curry; the parippu (lentil) curry is coconut-based, but whether any curry uses fish or dairy is not stated.
tokyo_spice_curry_shokudo_yotsuya.hours_raw: Daily 8:00–20:00 (last food order 19:30), open year-round, until sold out (Tabelog). Breakfast curry from 8:00 (2026 reviews). Ticket machine; cash only (Tabelog; October 2026). No reservations. 9 counter seats (4 + 5), facing outward; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). Small-size plates available (September 2026); a spiced tea is served (October 2026).
tokyo_spice_curry_shokudo_yotsuya.notes: [Curry · Yotsuya, a Sri Lankan breakfast-to-dinner curry counter] A nine-seat counter on the ground floor of a building off Shinjuku-dōri that serves Sri Lankan rice and curry every day from 8 a.m.: buy a ticket, and a plate arrives with jasmine rice, a spicy black chicken curry, a gentle coconut lentil parippu, a green-bean curry, pickled purple cabbage, carrot and coriander sambols and a crisp papadam to mix in, for ¥1,300. Diners in 2026 call it light and easy to eat, with little oil and no wheat flour in the curries, though one found it too lean and another too hot. A vegetarian curry is on the menu. Open daily until 20:00 or until it sells out; cash only.

chef_bio.background: No source names the cooks. An October 2026 diner quotes the shop's poster: "Curry from the Southern Islands, supervised by the SriLankan Airlines group chef". A web search shows a Gotanda shop with the same name and an Instagram account @spicecurryshokudo; whether it is a branch is not confirmed.

anecdotes.text: "Sri Lankan curry is said to be made without wheat flour and uses very little oil." — September 2026, chicken curry ¥1,300.
"It's wonderful that you can enjoy this for breakfast if you're in the Yotsuya area." — September 2026, parippu and black chicken.
"The oil is really minimal, which might leave you wanting a bit more." — November 2026.

tokyo_taishu_sakaba_tempura_miya_okachim.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: everything is wheat-batter tempura, tendon with sauce, or soba.
tokyo_taishu_sakaba_tempura_miya_okachim.vegan_detail: Vegan — ask: a vegetable tempura platter of seven vegetables is marked vegetarian (¥980, Tabelog menu), but the batter, dipping sauce and fryer are not described; a May 2026 diner had egg swapped for maitake.
tokyo_taishu_sakaba_tempura_miya_okachim.hours_raw: Mon–Sat, holidays and the day before 11:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); Sun and the day after a holiday 11:30–21:30 (last order 21:00); break 16:00–17:00 (Tabelog). Year-end: until 18:00 on 31 December; 1 January 11:30–20:00; 2 January 11:30–21:00. Reservations taken (the shop may call to confirm); the negi pork shabu-shabu hot pot needs a booking. Busy with overseas visitors (2026 reviews). 42 seats (8 at the counter, 34 at tables); private rooms for 6–20. Heated-tobacco-only smoking area. Cards, e-money and QR. English and Chinese menus and staff. Kids' menu; strollers welcome. Opened 30 June 2025.
tokyo_taishu_sakaba_tempura_miya_okachim.notes: [Tempura · Okachimachi, a tempura izakaya by Ameyoko] A large basement tempura bar a few minutes from Okachimachi Station, opened in June 2025 by the company behind Ueno's tempura-and-soba shops of the same name. At lunch it is a tendon shop: generous bowls of shrimp, shiso-wrapped squid, soft egg and vegetables (about ¥1,500–1,600, sometimes with a free size-up), or tendon with cold soba. At night it turns into a sake bar with tempura platters from ¥980 for vegetables to ¥2,980 for the house assortment with conger eel, plus small dishes and, in the colder months, a negi pork shabu-shabu that ends with soba. Many diners are visitors from abroad, and there are English and Chinese menus. One reviewer found the batter almost too crisp, and one regretted the lack of oshibori.

chef_bio.background: Run by 株式会社天ぷら宮 (Tempura Miya Co., Ltd.; representative 宮上秀一), which also runs 天丼と生蕎麦 天ぷら宮 上野本店 and 上野駅前店, the kakigori and matcha-crepe shops ミヤノ家, and 出汁と米 天むす宮 (company site). No source names the cooks here.
chef_bio.philosophy: Company site: "天ぷら専門店の集大成" — the culmination of its tempura shops.

anecdotes.text: "I enjoyed alternating between the smooth soba and the tempura, which was freshly fried and generously portioned at a reasonable price." — July 2026, zaru tendon ¥1,580.
"The anago (conger eel) had a crispy coating and a fluffy inside—truly exquisite." — May 2026.
"Shortly after, I was offered a free upgrade to a large size, which I gladly accepted." — August 2026, chicken and vegetable tendon ¥1,480.
"I ordered the premium tempura rice bowl, which was delicious, but it was a shame about the oshibori." — June 2026.

tokyo_yakiniku_gyusei_ueno.gf_detail: GF — ask: many cuts come with salt sauce, but marinated meats, sauces, cold noodles and stews are on the same menu and nothing is described as gluten-free.
tokyo_yakiniku_gyusei_ueno.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef yakiniku restaurant; namul and kakuteki are the vegetable sides, and the seasonings are not described.
tokyo_yakiniku_gyusei_ueno.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 15:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00; last order 22:30 (Tabelog). Reservations taken; cancellation fees from 23:00 two days before (100% of a course, or ¥3,000 per person for table-only). All-you-can-eat ¥4,620, with two-hour all-you-can-drink ¥5,940 (2026 reviews). Order by tablet (February 2026). One free grill change; later changes charged (February 2026). 88 seats; private hire for 20–50+. Designated smoking area. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR. BYO allowed (Tabelog).
tokyo_yakiniku_gyusei_ueno.notes: [Yakiniku · Ueno, value all-you-can-eat by the Shinobazu exit] A large, clean second-floor yakiniku restaurant three minutes from Ueno Station's Shinobazu Exit, built for groups. Most people book the all-you-can-eat course (¥4,620) or add two hours of drinks (¥5,940) and order by tablet: diamond-cut kalbi and outside skirt are the favourites, with beef-bone soup, spicy yukgaejang, kakuteki and cold noodles on the side. Reviewers in 2026 found the meat good for the price and the room quieter than most; the complaints are slow service when short-staffed, sauces and garlic only on request, and a charge after the first grill change. It opens at 15:00 on weekdays and noon at weekends, until 23:00.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog official listing. No source names the operator or cooks.

anecdotes.text: "The kalbi and outside skirt were tastier than those at other places in the same price range!" — November 2025.
"There are no sauces, lemon, gochujang, or garlic provided on the table. You need to call the staff each time you want something" — February 2026.
"This is an all-you-can-eat and drink course for JPY 5,940. I've visited several times, and for this price, the meat is delicious." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (公式情報): 焼肉DINING 牛勢 上野店、上野2-12-9 金栄ビル 2F、JR上野駅不忍口・上野御徒町駅A3・上野広小路駅A3から徒歩3分、月〜金・祝前日15:00〜23:00、土日祝12:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、予約可 (2日前23時からキャンセル料)、88席、分煙、カード可 (電子マネー・QR不可)、持ち込み可。メニュー (2026年2月): おまかせ盛り合わせ6種4,980円・8種6,980円・10種9,980円、カルビ780円、ダイヤモンドカットカルビ・ハラミ1,280円、黒毛和牛ヒレ1,780円、厚切り上タン2,580円。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月): 食べ放題4,620円、飲み放題付き5,940円、タブレット注文、網交換は1回無料、たれやにんにくは頼む必要、人手不足で提供が遅いことも、店内は清潔で静か。

tokyo_nikumeshi_okamoto_okachimachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: beef and offal braised in a sweet-savoury sauce over rice; nothing is described as gluten-free.
tokyo_nikumeshi_okamoto_okachimachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: braised beef, offal and pork; the tofu is cooked in the same pot.
tokyo_nikumeshi_okamoto_okachimachi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00 (Tabelog; may change). No reservations. Buy a ticket from the machine (cash or cashless, October 2026). Payment: AMEX, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 19 seats, mostly counter. Grand menu renewed 5 October 2026 (official site); an October 2026 regular found the set meals replaced by rice bowls. Opened 20 March 2023.
tokyo_nikumeshi_okamoto_okachimachi.notes: [Rice bowls · Okachimachi, braised beef over rice by the station] A busy counter by Okachimachi Station under a big "肉めし" sign, serving one idea: beef and tofu simmered for hours in a large pot and ladled over rice, with green onion, egg and pickled ginger to taste. There is also a motsu (offal) version, a sweet-spicy beef yakiniku bowl with a soft egg (¥1,045 in September 2026) and curry; the menu was redone into rice bowls in October 2026. Fast and filling, good for a solo meal, with a ticket for a free egg or large size on the next visit. Reviews are mixed on details — dry green onions, a disappointing limited-time misuji bowl, and slow table clearing on a busy Saturday. The brand began in Shinbashi in 2022 and grew to four shops by 2023; the official shop list now shows two, Shinbashi and this one (2 November 2026).

chef_bio.origin: Opened 20 March 2023 (Tabelog). The brand opened its first shop in Shinbashi in August 2022 and had four by September 2023 (Okachimachi, Adachi-Iriya, Mizonokuchi; DX Magazine, 17 September 2023); the official shop list of the operator shows two on 2 November 2026: Shinbashi and Okachimachi.
chef_bio.background: Run by Arcland Service (official site; DX Magazine names the operator as トビラダイニング in 2023). No source names the cooks.
chef_bio.philosophy: DX Magazine (2023): an evolved "niku meshi" born from the stubborn old man's market bowl, filling the bowl and the stomach.

anecdotes.text: "The onions and burdock root added a nice accent, and there was a generous portion of tofu as well." — October 2026, niku meshi.
"I visited after a long time and found that the set meal menu was gone, replaced by rice bowl options." — October 2026.
"However, instead of misuji, it seemed more like beef tendon with no fat." — September 2026, limited beef misuji bowl.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 肉めし岡もと 御徒町店、上野4-1-2、上野御徒町駅から79m、毎日11:00〜22:00、予約不可、19席、カード (AMEX)・電子マネー・QR可、2023年3月20日オープン。公式サイト (アークランドサービス): 2026年10月5日にグランドメニューを一新、9月に期間限定の牛みすじ丼。DXマガジン (2023年9月17日): 「頑固おやじが作る市場のぶっかけ飯」をもとにした進化系肉めしの専門店、大鍋で煮込んだ肉と豆腐、肉めし759円、牛すき肉めし979円、2022年8月に新橋に1号店、御徒町店、足立入谷店、4号店の溝の口店。公式の店舗一覧 (2026年11月2日): 新橋店と御徒町店の2店舗。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年10月): 肉めし、もつめし、牛ホルモン丼、牛焼肉めし1,045円、豚バラチャーシューのカレー、卓上の紅しょうがと「炎」、定食がなくなり丼に、ねぎが乾いていた、牛みすじ丼は期待外れという声。

tokyo_mille_higashiueno.gf_detail: GF — ask: pasta, gnocchi, focaccia and brioche are central; meat and fish courses are not described as gluten-free, so ask when booking.
tokyo_mille_higashiueno.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Ozaki beef, tripe, sausage, shirasu, gorgonzola and seafood; no vegan dish is named.
tokyo_mille_higashiueno.hours_raw: Lunch Tue–Fri 11:30–15:00 (last order 13:30, Fri 14:00); dinner Tue–Sat and holidays 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Mondays and Sundays (Tabelog). Reservations taken (a July 2025 diner walked in on a Thursday). No one under 20. Table charge ¥600. 8 counter seats. Non-smoking. BYO wine by arrangement, corkage ¥5,500 per bottle; bottles from the list can be bought to take home. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC and PayPay. Wine salons twice a month (Tabelog). Opened 1 May 2023.
tokyo_mille_higashiueno.notes: [Italian · Naka-Okachimachi, a one-chef wine counter] A hidden eight-seat counter on a quiet street between Okachimachi and Naka-Okachimachi, opened in 2023, where a chef who is also a sommelier cooks, pours and washes up alone. The food is simple Italian with a regional bent — ribollita, inzimino, Roman tripe, peposo, gnocchi, and Miyazaki's Ozaki beef — matched to wines from a featured region each month (Veneto in November 2026, Piemonte in December). Dinner is mostly omakase (¥11,000, or ¥18,000 with pairing), with some à la carte; weekday lunch is a four-course omakase from ¥7,800. Reviewers single out the pasta and the bread. One December 2025 diner found the solo-run room noisy and hectic and a dish too salty. No under-20s; ¥600 table charge.

roles: chef
sommelier
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing, the chef works alone and is a certified sommelier who hosts wine salons twice a month. Reviewers from July 2025 to February 2026 confirm a one-person operation. No source names the chef.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the listing: careful cooking and temperature of ingredients, simple but memorable dishes.
chef_bio.specialty: Wine pairing courses; pasta; Ozaki beef.

anecdotes.text: "Since the chef is working solo, it might allow for more focus on each dish." — July 2025, omakase with wine pairing.
"Due to the chef handling everything from cooking to taking orders and washing dishes, the sounds from the kitchen can be quite loud and hectic." — December 2025.
"I saw an unfamiliar dish name, Ribollita, on the menu, which turns out to be a soup made with beans, vegetables, and bread." — February 2026.

tokyo_morinoen_ningyocho.gf_detail: Ask. The soft serve comes in a cup or a cone, and the monaka shells are wafer; nothing is described as gluten-free.
tokyo_morinoen_ningyocho.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–19:00 (1F tea sales and soft serve); closed only over the New Year (Tabelog). The upstairs sweet shop closed on 1 December 2024 (Tabelog). Soft serve is sold from a counter at the side of the shop, with outdoor benches for about eight as the eat-in space (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC, nanaco, WAON, iD and PayPay (Tabelog). No reservations.
tokyo_morinoen_ningyocho.notes: [Sweets · Ningyocho, the hojicha soft serve from a tea shop] A Ningyocho tea shop whose single soft serve, flavoured with its own roasted hojicha, made Tabelog's Ice cream 100 for 2026 (it was a Japanese-sweets 100 pick in 2023). The flavour is deep and toasty, with the sweetness kept low, and the portion is generous: ¥600 in a cup or cone, or ¥800 with a little dog- or bear-shaped monaka filled with hojicha bean paste. Order at the side counter and eat on the benches outside; the upstairs sweet shop closed in 2024. One October 2026 diner noticed a drain smell at the benches and ate while walking instead. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: A tea shop selling tea on the ground floor; its upstairs sweet shop closed on 1 December 2024 (Tabelog). Selected for Tabelog Japanese-sweets TOKYO 100 in 2023 and Ice cream and gelato 100 in 2026 (Tabelog). An October 2026 diner credits the flavour to fresh milk and self-roasted hojicha.

anecdotes.text: "Upon entering from the front, I was told, 'Ice cream? You need to go to the side for that!'" — October 2026.
"The sweetness is kept to a minimum, allowing the hojicha flavor to shine through" — October 2026.
"I accidentally dropped some on my white jeans, and it didn’t come out completely" — October 2026.

tokyo_tori_suzu_ningyocho.gf_detail: Ask. Most skewers are salt-seasoned (September 2026), but the liver comes with sauce (September 2025), and kara-age, satsuma-age and soba are on the menu; nothing is described as gluten-free.
tokyo_tori_suzu_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori izakaya; vegetable skewers (shiitake, shishito, green onion) are on the menu.
tokyo_tori_suzu_ningyocho.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:20); Sat and holidays 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); the day before a holiday 17:00–23:00; closed Mon and Sun — open on Mondays in December; from July to September opens at 17:30 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted. Table charge ¥440 (Tabelog). Cards, transport IC, iD, QUICPay, PayPay and d Barai (Tabelog). 20 seats: 9 downstairs, 11 upstairs; private rooms for 2–10 (Tabelog). Smoking area for heated tobacco only (Tabelog). Opened 3 March 2006 (Tabelog). Popular cuts can sell out by 20:00 (March 2026).
tokyo_tori_suzu_ningyocho.notes: [Yakitori · Ningyocho, a 20-year charcoal yakitori house with sake] A two-storey yakitori izakaya a minute from Ningyocho station, open since 2006, grilling red-feathered chicken over charcoal, mostly with salt. The grilled liver is the dish to order: rare inside with sauce (September 2025), or with salt and sesame oil as a half portion for solo diners, as one fifteen-year regular has it (September 2026). The rare chicken breast with wasabi also wins praise. Beyond the skewers there are sashimi, yuba tofu made that morning, and soba or Amami chicken rice to finish, with an unusual sake and shochu list. Upstairs has semi-private rooms, and all-you-can-drink courses make it a group favourite. Some diners found the rooms dim and in need of cleaning (December 2025, June 2026), and popular cuts can run out by 20:00. ¥440 table charge.

chef_bio.background: Opened 3 March 2006 (Tabelog); the shop text celebrates 20 years of charcoal-grilled red-feathered chicken by skilled artisans (Tabelog). A diner has been coming for about 15 years (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Grilled liver; chicken with salt and sesame oil.

anecdotes.text: "The liver was cooked to a perfect rare in the center, pairing excellently with the sauce—simply exquisite." — September 2025.
"I always ask for a half portion, which is great for solo diners." — September 2026, on the grilled liver.
"In reality, it feels a bit dark and somewhat dirty." — December 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: とり鈴、焼き鳥、鶏料理、焼酎バー、日本橋人形町2-9-10、人形町駅A1出口から徒歩1分、火〜金17:00〜23:00、土・祝17:00〜22:00、祝前日17:00〜23:00、月・日休み (12月は月曜も営業、7〜9月は17:30から)、予約可、チャージ440円、カード・電子マネー・PayPay・d払い可、20席 (1階9、2階11)、個室、加熱式たばこのみの喫煙所、2006年3月3日オープン、炭火で焼く赤鶏、20周年、スタンダードコース4,730円、飲み放題付き7,480円と9,680円。口コミ(2024年9月〜2026年9月): 塩が中心の焼き鳥、レバーの塩ごま油焼き、ハーフも可、朝作った湯葉豆腐、刺身、うなぎ串の追加、日本酒と焼酎が多い、2階に半個室、店内が暗く清潔感に欠けるという声、人気の部位は20時に売り切れることも。

tokyo_yoshoku_koharuken_ningyocho.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–13:30 and 17:00–20:00, evening hours not fixed; Sat 11:00–13:30; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). No reservations; queues of up to about 20 at lunch (September 2026). No cards or QR; transport IC and nanaco accepted (Tabelog). 18 seats: four tables for four and a counter (Tabelog). No smoking during the day; smoking allowed at night (Tabelog). Founded in 1912 (2026 reviews).
tokyo_yoshoku_koharuken_ningyocho.notes: [Yoshoku · Ningyocho, the 1912 house of the egg-less katsudon] A yoshoku counter on Amazake Yokocho founded in 1912 by Tanemaru Kojima, who trained at Seiyoken in Tsukiji and cooked for the statesman Yamagata Aritomo (September, October 2026 reviews). Its famous katsudon is like no other: bite-sized pork cutlets buried under diced potato, carrot, onion and green pepper stewed in demi-glace, with a fried egg on top to break into the sauce (¥1,500). The fry platters, heavy on plump shrimp, and a hamburg steak under a runny egg are the other draws. The owner, the proprietress and the successor run the room warmly (October 2026). Queues build by noon, so arrive at 11:00. One September 2026 diner found cleaning supplies left in the dining room. No cards, but IC cards work; weekday evenings vary.

roles: The owner, the proprietress and the successor ("The hospitality from the proprietress, the owner, and the successor was exceptional", October 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: founded in 1912 (Meiji 45); the first owner, Tanemaru Kojima, trained at Seiyoken in Tsukiji, was a personal chef to Yamagata Aritomo and cooked at Chinzanso; the special katsudon was developed by the first owner (September, October 2026). Selected for Tabelog Yoshoku 100 in 2020 and 2022 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Katsudon with demi-glace vegetables and a fried egg.

anecdotes.text: "The first owner, Mr. Tanemaru Kojima, was a personal chef to the third and ninth Prime Minister of Japan, Yamagata Aritomo" — September 2026.
"When I arrived before opening, there wasn't much of a line, but by the time I left, nearly 20 people were waiting." — September 2026.
"However, cleaning supplies were visible in the dining area, which detracted from the overall ambiance." — September 2026.

tokyo_on_your_side_ningyocho.notes: [Bistro · Ningyocho, a wine bistro with a busy weekday lunch] A small second-floor wine bistro a minute from Ningyocho station, open since 2021, cooking a mix of French, Italian and Spanish dishes with a long glass-wine list. Lunch is the local favourite: weekly-changing sets from ¥1,500 of pasta, fish or meat with a colourful salad, bread and coffee, and a stamp card that earns a house dessert. Dinner runs to à la carte plates like pâté, tripe, oyster gratin and sea bream in américaine sauce, or courses from ¥6,500. Most diners praise the food and calm white room; one April 2026 lunch guest found the salad bland, the poêlé soggy and the iced coffee brought with the meal. At dinner a drink order is expected, plus a ¥500 charge.

chef_bio.background: Opened 30 November 2021 (Tabelog). A February 2026 diner describes the menu as the chef's favourite dishes from Italian, French and Spanish cooking. The Tabelog invoice registration is a corporate number, so no owner name is recorded.
chef_bio.specialty: Weekly lunch sets; pâté and tripe with wine.

anecdotes.text: "When you visit, you receive a stamp, and after collecting five, you can enjoy a handmade dessert from the restaurant." — July 2025.
"I was truly impressed by the 'Fresh Mushroom and Tomato Salad.' I never knew raw mushrooms could be so fragrant and delicious!" — November 2025.
"Just a note: since it’s a restaurant specializing in Western cuisine and wine, ordering alcohol is a must." — February 2026.

tokyo_freys_famous_pizzeria_roppongi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a Neapolitan pizzeria — wheat dough is the menu.
tokyo_freys_famous_pizzeria_roppongi.vegan_detail: Ask. A marinara pizza is on the menu (2026 reviews), but its ingredients are not described; most pizzas use cheese.

Lunch and dinner end when the dough runs out. Holiday-Monday openings are posted on Instagram (Tabelog). 16 seats: two tables for 4 and a counter of 8 + 2. Non-smoking. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB) and iD; no QR. Booking advised — small and busy, with many international visitors (September 2026).
tokyo_freys_famous_pizzeria_roppongi.notes: [Pizza · Roppongi, a small Neapolitan pizzeria near Midtown] A café-like room of 16 seats on a back street by Tokyo Midtown, with a wood-fired oven behind the counter, where chef Yamaguchi — formerly of SAVOY, the Neapolitan pioneer in Azabu-Juban, per a July 2026 diner — bakes about ten pizzas: margherita and marinara, bufala, a cheese pizza, the salami-and-pepper Papa's and a Sunny Side Up with egg. Selected for the Tabelog pizza 100 in 2017, 2018, 2019 and 2021. One 2026 diner calls it Roppongi's best pizza, others a relaxed spot for pizza and beer; one found the margherita ordinary and the egg pizza salty, and lunch can feel a little pricey. Closed Mondays; it closes early when the dough runs out.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yamaguchi (surname as written in a July 2026 review)
roles: Chef (July 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: A July 2026 diner writes that chef Yamaguchi previously worked at the renowned "SAVOY", which helped spread Neapolitan pizza culture from Azabu-Juban. Tabelog lists the shop in its pizza "Tabelog 100" for 2017, 2018, 2019 and 2021.
chef_bio.specialty: Margherita and marinara from a wood-fired oven.

anecdotes.text: "The Papa Pizza I had was incredibly delicious! The balance of the savory salami and the pepper's accent was exquisite, creating a simple yet addictive flavor." — October 2026.
"The Sunny Side Up combined the mildness of the egg with the saltiness of Italian parsley beautifully!" — September 2026, lunch.
"The texture of the crust was good, but while it was tasty, it didn’t leave a special impression; it felt quite ordinary." — July 2026, margherita.

tokyo_ten_kichi_roppongi.notes: [Set meals · Roppongi, a couple-run ¥1,000 lunch counter by Midtown] On the second floor of a building opposite Tokyo Midtown, a Showa-era room of a counter and a few tables where an elderly couple serve big ¥1,000 lunch sets to local office workers: mixed fry with shrimp, pork cutlet and ham cutlet, tonkatsu, pork sauté or grilled mackerel, each with rice, miso soup, natto, nori and pickles. Diners in 2025–2026 marvel at the portions and the price for Roppongi; one expected tempura and found set meals instead. With two people doing everything, food takes a while at noon. Cash only; weekdays only; smoking allowed.

tokyo_rio_grande_grill_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled meats are carved at the table, but the buffet includes curry, croquettes and fried dishes (2026 reviews); nothing is said about gluten.
tokyo_rio_grande_grill_roppongi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the salad bar is large (alfalfa, pea shoots, chickpeas, October 2026), but the meals are built around meat; feijoada is on the buffet.
tokyo_rio_grande_grill_roppongi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–23:00; Sat 11:30–15:30 and 17:00–23:00; Sun 11:30–15:30 and 17:00–22:30; open all year except 1 January; hours may change (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay and others). Samba show on Thursdays (Tabelog course). Busy at weekday lunch.
tokyo_rio_grande_grill_roppongi.notes: [Churrasco · Roppongi, an all-you-can-eat Brazilian grill with a terrace] A big, airy churrascaria of 164 seats with a terrace in the Pyramide building by Roppongi Hills, part of Create Restaurants' four-shop RIO GRANDE GRILL group. At dinner, servers bring skewers of wagyu, other beef cuts, chicken and shrimp to the table and carve to order, alongside a buffet of about fifty dishes with feijoada and desserts (¥6,690); lunch is a bargain for Roppongi, a grilled chicken or steak plate with the full salad bar from ¥1,550. Repeat diners come back for the salad bar; one diner wished staff managed the buffet queue at peak lunch. Samba shows on Thursdays.

chef_bio.origin: One of 4 RIO GRANDE GRILL shops (Roppongi, Ebisu, Yokohama Bay Quarter, Ikspiari) of Create Restaurants (official site)
chef_bio.background: Create Restaurants Holdings opened RIO GRANDE GRILL as a new churrasco concept in Roppongi and Yokohama on 23 April 2014 (atpress release). The official site now lists four shops. No one is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.philosophy: Dynamic Brazilian barbecue — churrasco of many cuts, mostly beef (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Churrasco carved at the table; salad bar.

anecdotes.text: "You choose a main dish, and the rest is all you can eat: salad, soup, curry, and dessert." — August 2026, grilled chicken lunch ¥1,550.
"The salad bar offers a variety of vegetables and desserts, and the fried banana might just be the standout dish among everything served at this restaurant." — October 2026, dinner.
"I've been here for both lunch and dinner, and it seems that the service and side dishes are much better in the evening, possibly due to the different pricing." — August 2026.
